verdicts_or_reports.element: Toggle done action / 'Add completion date' setting
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With Settings > todo.txt > 'Add completion date' unchecked, marking '(A) Pay rent' done should give 'x Pay rent pri:A' with no date.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Date is still added: line becomes 'x 2026-11-14 Pay rent pri:A' even though the setting is off.
steps: More > Settings > todo.txt, uncheck 'Add completion date' (it shows unchecked on reopening)
Open todo.txt, put cursor on line '(A) Pay rent'
Tap 'Toggle done' in the bottom bar
Line becomes 'x 2026-11-14 Pay rent pri:A' with a completion date

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: Covered todo.txt toggle done (set, reverse), the 'Add completion date' setting, editor File Settings toggles (Wrap Words, Line Numbers, Syntax Highlighting, Auto-format, Font Size), the Font picker previews and the saved font, and search and replace. Search and replace was tried with regex and capture groups, literal "$", the Single.md file with no trailing newline, undo, and rotation. One bug filed: Toggle done adds a completion date even when 'Add completion date' is off, and the developer confirmed it. I did not check visually that Wrap Words wraps long lines, and I did not test Match Case or Whole Word. Side effects of testing: todo.txt has an extra line 'x 2026-11-13 ', Indent.md has two extra lines, and the font is now Monospace.
